name: Greene's campaign in the Carolinas, 1780-81 (Cowpens to Guilford Courthouse)
notes: Morgan's detachment west of the Broad from 20 December 1780 (S95, map 3) to the battle of Guilford Courthouse. Cowpens is its first battle in the workbook; Guilford Courthouse and the campaign playback are to follow under this id.
